abstract.text: Regions divide a Project into broad areas. Layers describe levels or surfaces within a Region, such as a floor or indoor map.

inlineContent.text: Assign Locations to the appropriate Region and Layer so the Map can filter them. The Layer selector appears when the map’s center is inside a Layer polygon and lists Layers for that Region. Project Detail contains the Region and Layer tools; map editing supports area vertices and Location membership.

abstract.text: Locations are reusable Project places: entrances, rooms, checkpoints, stations, or delivery points.
Plan places, resources, and shared work across iOS and the web.
